hello.text: Lovely weather for it. Whatever 'it' is.

long.text: All my life. My mother was born in {npc.place}, and her mother too. I've never had cause to leave.

gossip.text: They say there's old stonework at {npc.ruin}, from before anyone remembers. Folk who go poking about up there come back with stories. Some don't come back at all.
